12.2.2
207:#### `allow-git`
208-
209-* Default: "none"
210-* Type: "all", "none", or "root"
211-
212-Limits the ability for npm to fetch dependencies from git references. That
213-is, dependencies that point to a git repo instead of a version or semver
214-range. Please note that this could leave your tree incomplete and some
215-packages may not function as intended or designed. Changing this setting
216-will not remove dependencies that are already installed.
217-
218-As of npm 12 the default is `none`. Git dependencies run `git` against a
219-remote repo and may install configuration the project does not control. Opt
220-in explicitly per project (in `.npmrc`) or per command (on the CLI) when you
221-need git deps.
---11
207:#### `allow-git`
208-
209-* Default: "all"
210-* Type: "all", "none", or "root"
211-
212-Limits the ability for npm to fetch dependencies from git references. That
213-is, dependencies that point to a git repo instead of a version or semver
214-range. Please note that this could leave your tree incomplete and some
215-packages may not function as intended or designed. Changing this setting
216-will not remove dependencies that are already installed.
217-
218-`all` allows any git dependencies to be fetched and installed. `none`
219-prevents any git dependencies from being fetched and installed. `root` only
220-allows git dependencies defined in your project's package.json to be fetched
221-and installed. Also allows git dependencies to be fetched for other commands
